response.sql:
SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time
FROM film AS f
WHERE f.length > 112
GROUP BY f.language_id
ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC, f.language_id
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: SQL AVG ignores NULL values; films with a missing length are excluded by the filter, and the other average includes every qualifying non-NULL replacement cost.
